action.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount - amount_paid) FROM ar_invoices WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND invoice_date <= DATE '2026-06-30') / (SELECT SUM(g.credit - g.debit) FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON g.account_id = a.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND a.type = 'Revenue' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-04' AND '2026-06') * 91 AS dso_days
